id: title:MichaelKutsch-ph:check for the posthog com tailnet and offer to switch

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostHog-specific account identification and account-switching safeguards to the Tailscale connection management tool, allowing PostHog infrastructure to distinguish its cluster account and switch accounts only with human oversight.
review.reason: Adds a PostHog-specific constant and account-switching helpers. P1.F3.H1 establishes the PostHog Tailscale account name. P1.F3.H2 adds account name extraction and a TTY check to prevent automated account switching. This is a localized, bounded implementation of account management and safety checks.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of account-switching safeguards and account identification. The tier does not account for unverified outcomes, such as whether account switching is actually performed or whether the account is successfully identified. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; scoring is done after this observation phase.

observations.behavior: Adds a constant and helper functions to support switching Tailscale accounts.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the PostHog-specific Tailscale account name used by the toolbox to identify the correct account for cluster access.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to extract the current Tailscale account name from status output.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the toolbox to distinguish whether the connected account is the PostHog account or another account.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to ask the user before switching accounts, returning False if stdin is not a TTY.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the toolbox to switch accounts only when a human is present, preventing automation from switching accounts.
